facts.content: Patient has experienced watery diarrhea for 3 days, about 5 to 6 times per day.
The patient had initial nausea and vomiting, with vomiting now resolved.
The patient has no blood in stools and no abdominal pain.
facts.source_text: No blood in stool; no abd pain

facts.content: The patient feels dehydrated with decreased appetite and decreased oral intake of solids, experiencing weakness.
facts.source_text: Feels dehydrated; ↓ appetite; ↓ PO solids; weakness

facts.content: Experienced subjective fever or warmth at the onset but now feels afebrile.
facts.source_text: Subjective fever/warmth at onset; now feels afebrile

facts.content: The patient has no headache or muscle pains.
The patient has consumed no suspect takeaway or restaurant food and has no known sick contacts.
facts.source_text: No suspect takeaway/restaurant food; no known sick contacts

facts.content: Patient has a history of asthma.
Patient uses a blue inhaler as needed.
Patient has no known drug allergies.
Patient's father had hypertension and died of bowel cancer about 10 years ago.
facts.source_text: Father HTN; died of bowel CA ~10 y ago.

facts.content: Patient's mother has type 2 diabetes mellitus.
Patient lives alone and is a software engineer.
Patient has been off work for 3 days.
Patient is a non-smoker and drinks alcohol socially.

Assessment is acute gastroenteritis with 3-day history of watery diarrhea, initial nausea and vomiting resolved, no blood or abdominal pain, with transient subjective fever, feeling dehydrated with decreased oral intake.
facts.source_text: 1) Acute gastroenteritis — 3 d watery diarrhea (5–6/day), initial N/V resolved, no blood/abd pain, transient subjective fever, feels dehydrated with ↓ PO

facts.content: Advised oral rehydration with ORS (Dioralyte).
Use paracetamol as needed for fever and weakness.
Stay off work until diarrhea-free for 24 to 48 hours.
Return to clinic if not improved by next week.
facts.source_text: F/U: If not improved next week, return to clinic
